purpose: Present read-only YAML with a filename, fold controls, highlighted-line guidance and copying.
behaviorProvider: Shared read-only CodeEditor, CopyButton and IconButton.

component: Render CodeEditor with language=yaml, readOnly and statusBar=false, passing the exact supplied text and optional wrap/height/highlight configuration.
Name the outer section from its generated filename ID and name the editor from label or the filename plus source. The visible filename is text, not a navigation/download link.
Provide named Fold all YAML sections and Unfold all YAML sections IconButtons invoking the editor handle. Text is not transformed or persisted by folding.
host: Supply source text and meaningful filename/label. Syntax highlighting and folding do not parse the YAML into trusted configuration or validate application semantics.
Supply valid intended one-based highlight ranges; the visual CodeEditor clips ranges to the document, while YamlPresenter describes the supplied ranges without normalization.

When highlight ranges exist, add a hidden textual list of their supplied bounds and associate it with the editor alongside CodeEditor keyboard instructions.

Consume code group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: No editing, YAML serialization, download or remote loading lifecycle is provided.
Copy requires browser clipboard permission and may show shared failure notification.
